The Reminder page

a little field guide · 日程 — things to do, dated or not ✿

Everything here lives on cards: write a thought, it becomes a card — with a date, a time range, a link, a colour, or nothing at all. One loop, five minutes: add → date → edit → done → delete, in real pictures.

1Write it down

Click the dashed composer, type, and pick a colour — Personal, Work, Utility, Other, or a Custom one.

2Give it a when (totally optional)

Press Add date — a little panel pops up. Pick a day (or type it), and if the hour matters choose a start time; the end fills itself in one hour later.

the panel, freshly opened

psst — no date? no problem. A card can stay undated forever. Dated ones feed the due soon disc (next 7 days · 未来七天), and timed ones show up on the Today planner too.
tap a day ♡

4Change your mind, right on the card

No edit screen anywhere. Click the title and type — Enter saves. Same for the link row and the chips; the little × takes a chip away.

was "Pay hydro bill" —
clicked, typed, done ✓
the whole family, side by side ↓

p. 3 / 4

5Tick it off ✓

Click the round checkbox and the app double-checks. Confirm, and the card retires — it leaves the grid and completed counts one up.

one click, counted
why the question? a finished reminder leaves the list — the tally remembers it, the grid does not. So the app asks first.

6See only what you need

The FILTER row narrows the grid to one colour. Click the same chip again (or All) to widen back out.

↑ Utility is doing the filtering here
shared with someone? username/password accounts using CloudBase can mark a reminder shared so it appears on both linked accounts' Reminder pages in real time; once linked, a shared-only chip joins this row. Firebase / Google accounts do not support this feature. (Connect accounts on the Account page.)

7Let one go

The little bin in a card's corner removes it — after one honest warning.

← it means it! no undo bin anywhere

…and that's the whole loop. Write, date, tick, repeat.

Happy remembering ✎
